instruction: Put the red cube on the green cube, let go and move the hand away.

outcome.real_measurement: A over B: horizontal distance of the two cube centres <= 2 cm (A's centre above B's top face) at every judged step. Real world: top camera.
A rests on B: | z(A) - z(B) - 4 cm | <= 5 mm at every judged step. Real world: RGB-D.
Supported by B: A-B contact impulse > 0 in every judged step. Real world: inferred from the poses + side camera.
A does not touch the table in the judged window. Real world: side camera.
B on the table: lowest bounding-box corner within 5 mm of the table top at every judged step. Real world: RGB-D pose vs table plane.
A lies flat on a face: the smallest angle of A's axes to vertical <= 10 deg. Real world: pose estimate.

Commanded vs actual opening (v3.2, E24c fix 3): for every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of a judged object, measured opening minus the free-space opening of its current gripper command <= 5 mm at every judged step (a gripper still closing on, or propped open by, something fails). Real world: gripper encoder vs command.

Consequence test after the judged window (protocol v3.1/v3.2): every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of either cube retracts its TCP 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s with its last gripper command unchanged, then holds 0.5 s; either cube must move <= 1 cm. Real world: same motion, tracked pose.
Settled: the fastest bounding-box corner of every judged object moves <= 2 cm/s at every judged step, speed from positions (v3.2, E24c fix 1). Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: the cubeA centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.
Stays put: the cubeB centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: grasp A, lift, align over B, lower onto B, open, retreat 10 cm up

counterexamples.name: hold_on_top
counterexamples.description: A put on B, gripper stays closed on A

counterexamples.name: cage
counterexamples.description: A put on B, gripper opened only ~1.5 mm beyond the cube width (no contact, still around A)

counterexamples.name: press_on_top
counterexamples.description: A released on B, then the closed gripper presses down on A's top face

counterexamples.name: beside
counterexamples.description: A put on the table touching B, released, retreat

counterexamples.name: no_op
counterexamples.description: the arm stays at its start pose

source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 signals (imsim/imsim/verify/v32.py): position-based speeds, all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath, commanded vs actual opening, 5 s settle cap
source.released_code_predicate: A within (|half_xy| + 5 mm) of B horizontally, |dz - 4 cm| <= 5 mm, A's PhysX velocity < 1 cm/s and 0.5 rad/s, not is_grasping(A) (finger forces >= 0.5 N at < 85 deg), one step

notes: Release over both cubes (contact + all-link enclosure), commanded vs actual opening, retreat over both cubes.
